GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 332.1 (8 Dec 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1831)
APO 500
8 December 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Display of National Flag.
1. There is no objection to the display of the Japanese national flag on 25 December 1947 as requested by C.L.O. No. 9311(PH) dated 4 December 1947.
2. Occupation troops will be informed in this matter.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
